name: Stohin z Hlybyn
source:
It was a typical hot day, too warm for most to think of leaving the house. But the two girls had plans, and those plans led straight to the first-ever modern art exhibition in their town.

[From [url=https://frezivi.itch.io/stohinzhlybyn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是典型的炎热天气，太热了，大多数人都不想离开家。但这两个女孩有计划，这些计划直接导致了她们镇上的第一次现代艺术展览。
